messages.content: Who has the highest number of hearts in a game of poker?

function.name: play_poker

message.content:
In a standard 52‑card deck, the **maximum** number of hearts a single player can hold in a hand depends on the poker variant:

| Game | Cards dealt to a player | Community cards | Total cards a player can use | Max hearts a player can hold |
|------|------------------------|-----------------|------------------------------|------------------------------|
| **Texas Hold’em** | 2 hole cards | 5 community cards | 7 cards | **7 hearts** |
| **Omaha** | 4 hole cards | 5 community cards | 7 cards | **7 hearts** |
| **Five‑Card Draw** | 5 cards | 0 community cards | 5 cards | **5 hearts** |
| **Seven‑Card Stud** | 7 cards | 0 community cards | 7 cards | **7 hearts** |

So, in the most common variants (Hold’em, Omaha, Seven‑Card Stud), the **highest possible number of hearts a player can have is 7**. In Five‑Card Draw, the maximum is 5.

If you’re asking “who” in a particular game, it would simply be the player who happens to be dealt that many hearts. In a typical hand, the player with the most hearts will usually have a **flush** (five hearts) or, in the case of Texas Hold’em/Omaha/Stud, could even have a **seven‑card flush** if all seven cards are hearts.
